This project is part of a larger collaborative effort called DUNEX (During Nearshore Event Experiment) that is funded through the US Coastal Research Pro- gram (USCRP, https://uscoastalresearch.org, last access: 21 November 2023).
The overall goal of DUNEX is to use rapid-response or other event-focused measurements and models to improve understanding of coastal impacts during storm events.
As a part of DUNEX, a 27 d field experiment was held from 3 to 30 October 2021.
Dur- ing the field experiment, we measured the motion of small- scale, free-drifting microSWIFT buoys in the inner shelf and surf zone.
